verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Portkey's own built-in Logs view, shareable log URLs, and in-product tracing and metrics. Nothing shows exporting logs or traces to an external observability stack: no OpenTelemetry export, log-export API, or third-party sink integration. Native in-product observability is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for an export story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export gateway logs and traces to my own observability stack
